notes.title: "Solitaire Ultimate Bundle" is now available!
notes.content:
The Pretty Girls first brought their unique Mahjong Solitaire to you in "RED" and it has been one of our top selling titles. To expand your enjoyment we've recently released a new version of Pretty Girls based this time on classic Klondike solitaire rules.

[b]◆Solitaire Ultimate Bundle[/b]
Titles included in the bundle:
・ Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire
・ Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire
・ Delicious! Pretty Girls Mahjong Solitaire
・ Bishoujo Battle Mahjong Solitaire

Complete the set or pick up all four at a great 30% off discount.  
Try different rules and different girls and different solitaire games!

For more information[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18086/]click here[/url]
----------------------

notes.title: Save now with the Bishoujo Battle Bundle!
notes.content:
We recently launched a third exciting casual title featuring the bishoujo girls from "Rikku☆Jiasu" (Rick G Earth) mobile military turn-based strategy game from Japan. 

Also, we've upgraded the Bishoujo Battle Bundle to include all three! Buy all three games and get a special 20% off bundle discount. If you already had a chance to pick up either or both of our earlier Bishoujo Battle titles then this is your chance to complete the set at a great low price.

For more details [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15186/Bishoujo_Battle_Bundle/]click here to check out the bundle page.[/url]
